heading: Liji 20 · Ji Fa 祭法 · The Law Of Sacrifices · Ji Fa 1 … Ji Fa 6

items.text: Maintain seven ancestral temples: offer monthly sacrifices in the five near temples, seasonal sacrifices in the two more remote, and occasional altar sacrifices as prescribed.
items.quote: Thus the king made for himself seven ancestral temples, with a raised altar and the surrounding area for each.

items.text: Maintain five ancestral temples: offer monthly sacrifices in the three near temples, seasonal sacrifices in the two more remote, and occasional altar sacrifices as prescribed.
items.quote: A feudal prince made for himself five ancestral temples

items.text: Maintain three ancestral temples and two altars: offer seasonal sacrifices in the three near temples, and raise altars and sacrifice to more remote ancestors when occasion requires.
items.quote: A Great officer made for himself three ancestral temples and two altars.

items.text: Maintain two ancestral temples and one altar: offer seasonal sacrifices in the two near temples, and raise an altar and sacrifice to the great-grandfather when occasion requires.
items.quote: An officer of the highest grade had two ancestral temples and one altar

items.text: Maintain one ancestral temple for your father; sacrifice to your grandfather in that temple, and leave more remote ancestors in their ghostly state.
items.quote: An officer in charge merely of one department had one ancestral temple; that, namely, of his father.
items.needs_role: officer in charge of one department

items.text: Have no ancestral temple; present offerings to your dead in the back apartment as occasion requires.
items.quote: Their dead were left in their ghostly state, (to have offerings presented to them in the back apartment, as occasion required).

heading: Liji 20 · Ji Fa 祭法 · The Law Of Sacrifices · Ji Fa 7 … Ji Fa 9

items.text: Offer sacrifice to the discontented ghosts of your predecessors who died without posterity, so they are not left unremembered.
items.quote: one for the discontented ghosts of his predecessors who had died without posterity
items.conflict: Sacrifice to the dead conflicts with Deut. 18:10-12; honor ancestors without offerings.

items.text: Offer sacrifice to your ancestors who died prematurely—rightful eldest sons, grandsons, and further descendants—according to the number of generations permitted by your rank.
items.quote: sacrificed to five classes of those who had died prematurely: to the rightful eldest sons, grandsons, great-grandsons, great-great-grandsons, and to the rightful sons of these last
items.conflict: Sacrifice to the dead conflicts with Deut. 18:10-12; honor ancestors without offerings.
